question: how much of each primary record's gross reserves sits outside the years its triangle develops, and what do the fit and the vignette stresses become without the records where it is above 30%?
measure: share = 1 - (gross reserves of the years the stored grid develops) / CO_g; a script measure, not a reading (bucket_share.py's docstring gives each method and its order)

unmeasured_reason_text.line_text: the reserve line's text does not end with the census's amounts
unmeasured_reason_text.no_total: the census placed no reconciling gross total for the table
unmeasured_reason_text.single_total: the table's reconciling total is a single amount: the reserves by year were not placed
unmeasured_reason_text.bucket_unplaced: an older-years line is printed but carries no single reserve amount the script can place
unmeasured_reason_text.dlp_not_payments: the design's diagonal-less-paid measure was not placed by a reader and rests on a line that is not a gross payments line of the grid's years, or falls outside [-2%, 100%]
unmeasured_reason_text.fewer_cells: the reserve line has fewer year cells than the stored grid has years
unmeasured_reason_text.no_ordering: neither ordering of the reserve line keeps every developed year within its latest incurred estimate
unmeasured_reason_text.ambiguous_ordering: both orderings of the reserve line fit and give different shares, and neither is clearer

adjudication_comparison.note: the adjudication's script measure (pop_classified.json) on the same records: measured in its classes 'reserves outside the developed years (measured)', 'table covers the reserves (within 2%)' and 'older-years column developed in the grid'

operator_construction: size-only operator: gamma fixed at 0 in the likelihood (the headline fit); a refit, not a zeroing: k, sigma_undiv, sigma_div, nu_clean and nu_RITC are that fit's own posterior. sigma does not depend on H, so the concentration channel of any decomposition is exactly zero
rule: without the 19 primary records whose measured older-years share is above 30% (adjudication.md, Q5 option B); the 161 records whose share is not measured stay in the fit
